scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide view of a city street with tall buildings lining both sides, including a large white building with many windows and balconies, and a smaller building with a rounded corner and a statue on top. The street has a few cars parked along the curb and a person walking down the sidewalk. The sky is overcast.
scene_analysis.buildings: The large white building has a mix of rectangular and arched windows, with balconies on each floor. It has a flat roof with several small towers and turrets. The smaller building has a more ornate facade with columns and arches. There are also some trees and bushes along the sidewalk.
